name: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (DAAQU), a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) based in the Cayman Islands, was established with the core objective of completing a significant business combination. This could involve a merger, asset acquisition, share exchange, or other similar strategic transactions with one or more operating businesses. The company intends to concentrate its search efforts on identifying private enterprises within the burgeoning digital asset and cryptocurrency industries, aiming to facilitate their entry into the public markets. Each unit offered consists of a single Class A ordinary share along with one-half of a redeemable warrant, with whole warrants becoming exercisable at $11.50 per share.
